environment: WSL2/QEMU/KVM x86 L6; not physical ARM capacity
limits: Rates and UDP lengths describe iperf application payload, not Ethernet wire rate.
DUT, generator and hypervisor limits are different; direct headroom does not prove a physical router capacity.
A complete matrix may contain packet loss or SLA degradation under offered overload; inspect every observation.
Disk counters include delayed RouterOS configuration commits; short runs alone do not establish steady flash wear.
Container cgroup memory is not process RSS. These base-image runs do not expose RSS.
CPS and physical ARM/ARM64 performance are unmeasured.
dut_network_model: QEMU emulated e1000; rootless TCP socket links
reasons_not_capacity_validated: Large TCP variation across repeats and before/after controls. Six-second post-admission settle is not a performance steady-state qualification.
Direct small-packet UDP endpoint path did not deliver the offered 50 Mbit/s losslessly. TCP bandwidth headroom does not establish PPS headroom.
No physical ARM/ARM64 devices or controlled bare-metal NIC measurement.
Offered/received application rates and RouterOS counters cannot separate all QEMU, virtual NIC and DUT bottlenecks.
traffic_recovery_timing_limit: New TCP completion times include a 3-second transfer and an explicit 6-second settle after recovery; they are not first-packet outage measurements.

rss_diagnostic.scope: Separate paced TCP20M run, same two WANs/three policies/six probes and exact CI base image; temporary RouterOS RAM logging. Normal matrix logging was disabled.
